label: Bible Study
prompt: Feed the _____ of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verse: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
note: Peter, once told 'Feed my sheep,' now passes the charge on to church elders.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the _____ is not your's, but God's.
verse: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not your's, but God's.
note: A vast army is coming; the prophet Jahaziel tells King Jehoshaphat the battle isn't yours, but God's.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat _____ as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.
verse: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.
note: Proud Nebuchadnezzar ate grass like an ox until he learned who really rules — then he praised the King of heaven.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the _____ of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verse: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
note: The tree of life, barred in Genesis 3, stands on both riverbanks — with leaves for the healing of nations.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men _____; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
verse: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
note: Seven hundred 'lefthanded' Benjamites could sling a stone at a hair and not miss. Ehud was a lefthanded Benjamite too (3:15).
